title: Erdős #307: Prime Reciprocal Products — Complete Proof

problemStatement.formal: \nexists \text{ finite prime sets } P, Q \text{ s.t. } \left(\sum_{p \in P} \frac{1}{p}\right)\left(\sum_{q \in Q} \frac{1}{q}\right) = 1
problemStatement.plain: Are there two finite sets of primes P, Q with (Σ 1/p)(Σ 1/q) = 1? The prime version is OPEN. The coprime version was solved by Cambie: (1 + 1/5)(1/2 + 1/3) = 1.
